pages.title: Language adapter architecture
pages.rationale: Why an adapter is four shell functions rather than a plugin system, why every inventory record names its extraction strategy, why absent native tooling never fails a run, why Go always uses the awk pass, and why shell detects last.

pages.title: Staleness, idempotency and the manifest
pages.rationale: Why inputs_hash and content_hash are separate concerns, what compute_inputs_hash covers in stable order, and how a committed manifest makes a second run do no work; readers who miss this misread every skip message.

pages.title: The Diataxis mode contract
pages.rationale: Why every page carries exactly one mode, why reference pages come from derive_reference_pages instead of the model, why a two-goal how-to returns a split, and why more than three tutorials is warned about.

pages.title: Why the harness owns the filesystem
pages.rationale: The central security and reviewability boundary: claude_run pins the model, allows only Read, Grep and Glob, forces --strict-mcp-config and schema-validated structured output, and only the shell writes to the tree, so a prompt injection in a source comment cannot touch the repository.

pages.title: Authenticate runs for continuous integration
pages.rationale: One goal distinct from doctor troubleshooting: supply bare-capable credentials so check does not exit 16, via claude setup-token, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or an apiKeyHelper through settings_file.

pages.title: Diagnose environment and authentication failures
pages.rationale: One goal: turn a doctor failure into a fix, since each check in preamble_run exits with a distinct code from 10 to 16 and carries its own remediation line.

pages.title: Gate pull requests on documentation freshness
pages.rationale: One goal: run check only on pull requests and map its exit codes 30, 31 and 32 to a failing job; the shipped snippet under share/integrations has no derived reference page, so this page carries it.

pages.title: Regenerate a single page
pages.rationale: One goal from the generate flags: narrow a run with --mode and --page (slug or docs path) and override the up-to-date skip with --force.

pages.title: Review and edit the page plan
pages.rationale: One goal from cmd_plan: read the .diataxis/plan.json diff before spending money, keep slugs stable across refreshes, and act on the more-than-three-tutorials warning and the slug-mode mismatch failure.

pages.title: Vendor the harness into a repository
pages.rationale: One goal from install.sh: get diataxis/ committed into a target repo by script, subtree or submodule, including the refuse-if-DEST-exists and starter-config behavior.

pages.title: Generate your first documentation set
pages.rationale: One beginner journey ending in a concrete artifact: a vendored harness, a config, a reviewed plan.json and a docs/ tree, following the README quick start order of doctor, init, plan, generate, check.

pages.title: Audit versus check
pages.rationale: Why the rule set splits into deterministic local rules that cost nothing and judgment rules that need a model call, why audit always exits 0 while check maps severities to exit codes, and why generation stays out of pull request CI.

pages.title: Model routing and cost
pages.rationale: Routing is by the judgment a mode requires, not output length: explains the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku split, why exact model ids beat family aliases, why fallback divergence marks a page stale instead of passing silently, and why Fable-tier models are refused.

pages.title: Reproducibility and bare mode
pages.rationale: The sharpest tradeoff in the tool: --bare buys reproducibility by skipping hooks, plugins and CLAUDE.md but also skips keychain auth, which constrains how you authenticate; covers the auto resolution and why check refuses to run without it.

pages.title: Tutorial verification and repair
pages.rationale: Why tutorials are the one mode whose code is executed, how block extraction and the bounded repair loop feed failure output back into a regeneration, and what a verified: false page means downstream in check.

pages.title: Configure a multi-language monorepo
pages.rationale: One goal from the workspaces array: point the harness at several directories, pin or auto-detect an adapter per workspace, and namespace pages by workspace name.

pages.title: Control spend with a budget
pages.rationale: One goal from the cost accounting: cap a run with --budget-usd or budget_usd, read the breakdown from cost, and understand the refuse-to-start behavior that exits 20 instead of half-generating.

pages.title: Protect hand-written pages from regeneration
pages.rationale: One goal from the human-edit protection in manifest.sh: keep an edited or hand-authored page with frozen: true, and understand why the harness refuses to overwrite an edited or untracked page without --force.

pages.title: Resolve audit findings
pages.rationale: One goal from the audit rubric: work through mode_mixing, title_not_task_shaped, unverified_code, broken_citation, stale, orphan and missing_reference, and apply the fix each finding names.

pages.title: Route modes to different models
pages.rationale: One goal from the models config block: override the per-mode model and effort, set the fallback, and control the reference_bulk route that triggers at 25 or more inventory symbols; the config keys have no derived reference page, so this page documents them.

pages.title: Run the harness test suite
pages.rationale: One goal for a contributor: run shellcheck and bats exactly as continuous integration does, using the hermetic PATH shim, and opt into the live smoke test with DIATAXIS_LIVE=1 under a capped budget.

pages.title: Verify tutorial code in a container
pages.rationale: One goal from the verify config block: replace the default ephemeral host directory with a sandbox_command wrapper, and tune executable_languages and max_repairs.

pages.title: Why POSIX shell and jq
pages.rationale: The implementation and anti-goal boundary: Bash 3.2 compatible shell with jq as the only parser keeps the harness vendorable into any repository with no language runtime dependency, and rules out a site generator, theme or plugin system.

pages.title: Inspect a run without calling the model
pages.rationale: One goal from --dry-run: print the exact claude argv, one argument per line, to confirm model, effort, tool restrictions and budget flags before spending anything.

pages.title: Remove generated pages that left the plan
pages.rationale: One goal from the clean subcommand: delete manifest-tracked pages that are no longer planned, while frozen and hand-edited pages survive without --force.

pages.title: Run a large generation concurrently
pages.rationale: One goal from --concurrency: raise batch parallelism up to the cap of 4 for a first full generation, and know that workers only write to a temp directory while the parent applies every repository write and manifest update serially.

pages.title: Set the documentation voice and style
pages.rationale: One goal from the voice config block: pick a style guide and person, and append project-specific instructions through extra_instructions_file, which are merged into every system prompt in a temp directory.

pages.title: Write a language adapter
pages.rationale: Learning by doing for a new contributor: implement the four adapter functions against a fixture repository and get a golden plan comparison passing, which carries too much scaffolding to be a recipe and ends in a working artifact.
